notes.title: Steamdeck Support
notes.content: Fixed a bug on steamdeck when rendering the splash screen.

notes.title: First Day Patches
notes.content:
Thanks for playing everyone! 
[list]
[*] Fixed double-free bug when multiple players overlap a powerup.
[*] Reduced asteroid spawn rate in Laser Shield episode.
[*] Adjusted balance of Mortar boss.
[*] Improved performance on collision detection between bogeys. 
[/list]

notes.title: SHMUP Fest Demo with New Art!
Demo Update
notes.content:
This update to the demo adds a few things:
[list]
[*] Duet mode for local co-op
[*] Improved boost ability. It's zippier with more oomph.
[*] Waves have a better cadence and flow.
[*] Powerups spawn more often.
[*] More opportunities to rescue captured ships.
[*] Boss appears earlier. 
[/list]
